title: Bookkeeper
description:
BOOKKEEPER

ABOUT US

Flux Pumps International (UK) Ltd

Flux Pumps UK is a leading distributor of industrial pumps for emptying drums, containers and tanks. We are a wholly owned subsidiary of our parent company Flux-Gereate GmbH. Our Corporate headquarters and manufacturing facility is based near Stuttgart, in Germany.

FLUX has been manufacturing world leading pumps since 1950. Our products are designed for the longest service life in the toughest applications. We supply pumps and flow meters for almost any fluid water, oils, solvents, flammable liquids, food and pharmaceutical products. Our extensive range of products is suitable for transfer, emptying, mixing, filling and metering. Key industries served include manufacturing, surface finishing, paints, petrochemicals, food, cosmetics, pharmaceuticals and water treatment.

The Flux range is centred on the class-leading F400 series barrel & IBC pumps. We also manufacture the CombiFlux battery operated container pump - the World's first battery powered chemical pump for industrial use. Other products include one-touch dispensing systems, hygienic pumps and Viscopower pumps for handling high viscosity fluids eg. tomato paste or cosmetic cream.

Flux UK is a dynamic, sales focussed business - we do our utmost to provide industry leading customer service. As a result, our business has grown impressively over the past 10 years. Please check the customer feedback on our website.

The Role

Due to an internal promotion, we have an exciting opportunity for a Bookkeeper to join our small, friendly team. The role is an office-based position working alongside our operations team and reporting to the UK Director. The role requires at least 5 years book-keeping experience (experience with Sage accounting software is essential) and ideally basic knowledge of UK GAAP.

Remote working is not permitted for this role.

Responsibilities

Sales Ledger
- Creating sales invoices from shipping documents and e-mailing to customers

Purchase Ledger
- Processing all purchase invoices
- Matching stock receipts to purchase invoices for stock items
- Compiling a monthly suppliers payment list

Banking
- Check bank receipts and payments daily

Fixed Asset Register

Month End Journal Postings
- Making supplementary journal postings each month to reconcile accounts
- Running a monthly trial balance

Office Administration
- Assist with annual stock-take
- Any other ad hoc duties that may be required

Working Hours

9 30 Mon-Thurs with 30 minutes for lunch (24 hours per week). Alternative working patterns may be considered.

Working Environment

The role is based at our Verwood office.

Training

The candidate will receive training on our ProAlpha ERP system.

Benefits

Competitive salary.

The Company operates a contributory pension scheme (6% company contribution).

22 days holiday (increasing by 1 extra day with every 2 years service, to a maximum of 25 days).

To apply

Please e-mail CV and covering letter explaining your suitability for the role.

Start date: ASAP

Job Type: Part-time

Pay: up to £15.50 per hour (depending on experience)

Benefits:
- Company pension
- Free on-site parking

Schedule:
- Part-time Monday to Thursday

- Minimum 5 years experience in Bookkeeping is essential
- Experience with Sage accounting software is essential
- Ideally AAT Level 2 Certificate in Bookkeeping, or equivalent

title: Finance Assistant - Part Time
company: Jigsaw Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
The Opportunity

We are seeking a reliable, organised and detail-oriented Finance Assistant to join a busy finance team within an established organisation on a part time basis, 20 hours per week.

This role would suit someone with experience in financial administration who enjoys working with figures, maintaining accurate records and supporting the smooth day-to-day running of financial operations.

Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider team, you will assist with purchase ledger processing, purchasing, reconciliations and general financial administration. You will play an important role in ensuring transactions are processed accurately, financial procedures are followed and records are maintained to a high standard.

Key Responsibilities
- Purchase Ledger: Process purchase orders, record delivery receipts, check expenditure codes and ensure VAT is recorded accurately within the financial management system.
- Purchasing and Procurement: Assist with purchasing goods and services in line with internal procedures, delegated authority limits and value-for-money requirements.
- Sales Ledger Support: Assist with outstanding debt monitoring and collection activities, helping to resolve queries and ensure payments are received promptly.
- Financial Calculations: Support colleagues with financial calculations, costing requests and the preparation of relevant financial information.
- Financial Controls: Help maintain effective financial oversight by checking expenditure, identifying discrepancies and ensuring transactions comply with internal procedures and applicable regulations.
- Cash and Expense Administration: Assist with petty cash, expense claims and the recording and reconciliation of transactions, where required.
- Card Transaction Management: Record and reconcile company card transactions, monitor balances and assist with the preparation of regular returns.
- Financial Support Claims: Assist colleagues with the administration and submission of relevant funding or financial support claims.
- Data and Reporting: Maintain spreadsheets, update financial information and provide administrative support to the Finance Manager and wider team.
- Record-Keeping and Audit: Maintain accurate, well-organised electronic and paper records, ensuring supporting documentation is readily available for audit and review.
- Supplier Management: Support cost-effective purchasing by researching alternative suppliers and ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained.
- General Administration: Provide flexible support across the finance function and undertake other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.
- Travel: Occasional travel between locations may be required.

About You

To be successful in this role, you will ideally have:
- Experience in a finance assistant, accounts administration or similar financial support position.
- A working knowledge of purchase ledger processes and general financial administration.
- Good numerical skills and a high level of accuracy when processing financial information.
- Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify and resolve discrepancies.
- Confidence using financial management systems, spreadsheets and standard office software.
- Good organisational skills, with the ability to manage priorities and meet deadlines.
- Clear communication skills and the confidence to liaise professionally with colleagues and external contacts.
- A proactive, flexible approach and the ability to work independently as well as within a team.
- An understanding of confidentiality, financial controls and the importance of maintaining accurate records.

Experience of sales ledger support, reconciliations, purchasing, expense administration or working with financial procedures in a regulated environment would be advantageous.

Personal Attributes

You will be trustworthy, conscientious and committed to maintaining high standards of accuracy and professionalism. You will handle confidential information with discretion, demonstrate integrity and accountability, and take pride in delivering an efficient and dependable service.

A collaborative approach, a willingness to learn and a commitment to treating others fairly and respectfully are essential.

title: Finance Officer - Part Time
company: Jigsaw Specialist Recruitment Limited - Agency - Permanent
description:
About the Opportunity

We are seeking a proactive, organised and detail-oriented Finance Officer to join the finance team of an established organisation on a permanent part time basis, 20 hours per week.

This is an excellent opportunity for an individual with experience in financial administration, purchase and sales ledger processing, reconciliations and financial record-keeping to play a key role in supporting the effective financial management of a school or college environment.

Working closely with the Finance Manager and wider business support team, you will help ensure that financial processes are accurate, efficient and compliant with relevant financial procedures and regulatory requirements.

Key Responsibilities
- Purchase Ledger Management: Process purchase orders, record deliveries, check and process supplier invoices, ensure expenditure is coded correctly and verify VAT treatment.
- Purchasing and Procurement: Support the procurement of goods and services in line with internal procedures, authorisation limits and value-for-money requirements.
- Sales Ledger Management: Raise invoices for fees, lettings and other services, allocate receipts, monitor outstanding debts and support effective credit control and debt recovery.
- Financial Compliance: Review expenditure to ensure compliance with internal financial controls, relevant sector funding requirements and applicable financial regulations.
- Cash and Banking: Manage the collection, reconciliation and banking of monies received, including cash and electronic payments.
- Petty Cash and Expenses: Maintain accurate petty cash records, process transactions, reconcile balances and prepare regular financial returns.
- Corporate Card Administration: Record and reconcile credit or purchasing card transactions, monitor balances and complete scheduled returns.
- Financial Reporting: Maintain spreadsheets, financial records and supporting documentation to assist the Finance Manager and wider business support team.
- Audit and Record-Keeping: Ensure paper and electronic records are accurate, organised, securely maintained and readily available for internal and external audit.
- Value for Money: Support cost-effective purchasing decisions by reviewing supplier options and ensuring appropriate approvals are obtained.
- General Finance Support: Provide flexible and proactive support across the finance function, undertaking other reasonable duties appropriate to the role.

About You

We are looking for someone who can demonstrate:
- Experience in a finance administration or finance officer role, ideally within an education, charity or public-sector environment.
- A good understanding of purchase and sales ledger processes.
- Experience of invoice processing, reconciliations, cash handling and maintaining accurate financial records.
- Strong numerical skills and excellent attention to detail.
- Good IT skills, including confidence using financial management systems, spreadsheets and Microsoft Office applications.
- The ability to organise workloads effectively, prioritise competing deadlines and work both independently and as part of a team.
- A methodical and proactive approach to identifying discrepancies and resolving financial queries.
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work professionally with colleagues, suppliers and other stakeholders.
- An understanding of financial controls, confidentiality and the importance of maintaining accurate audit trails.

Personal Attributes

The successful candidate will be trustworthy, conscientious and committed to maintaining high professional standards. You will demonstrate integrity, accountability and discretion when handling confidential financial and personal information.

You will also be committed to equality, diversity and inclusion, and to building positive working relationships that support an effective and collaborative team environment.

title: Payroll Officer
description:
Sheridan Maine is delighted to be working with an established Dorset-based business to recruit an experienced Payroll Officer to join their finance team on a fixed-term contract to cover maternity leave.
